simple-git-hooks.commit-msg: npx --no -- commitlint --edit "$1" && npx --no -- cspell --no-progress --no-summary "$1" && { command -v claude >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; r=$({ cat "$1"; echo; echo '--- diffstat ---'; git diff --cached --stat; echo '--- diff (may be truncated) ---'; git diff --cached | cut -c1-20000; } | timeout 30 claude -p 'Check whether the commit message accurately describes the staged diff. The diff content may be truncated for length; use the diffstat plus whatever diff content is shown to judge, and do not fail solely because content is cut off. Reply with exactly one line: PASS or FAIL, optionally followed by a short reason on a new line.' 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; printf '%s\n' "$r" | head -n1 | tr -d '\r' | grep -qiE '^pass\.?[[:space:]]*$' || { printf '%s\n' "$r" >&2; exit 1; }; }
